messages.author: 96e630cb74e1964d
messages.subject: Re: geom_pointrange
parts:
Hello:

So I have a dataframe like:

minmedmax[1,]
Month CATCHMENT_ med min max
1 February Alknda01 2.10248 0.381947 5.17419

p <- ggplot(minmedmax,aes(x = Month, y = med, ymin = min, ymax = max,
subset = CATCHMENT_ == "Yamuna08"), fill = "white") +
ylab("Precipitation (mm/day)\n") + opts(title = subbasin)

p + geom_pointrange(linetype = 2, colour = "navyblue") +
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.text.y =
theme_text(colour = "black")) + opts(axis.line = theme_segment(colour
= "black")) + opts(axis.ticks = theme_segment(colour = "white"))


What I would like to do is add some horizontal hashmarks through the
middle point and at the ends as well. Something about as large as the
horizontal lines in geom_errorbar. (BTW, why don't the ends of the
range manifest themselves as points? For each month I only have three
points - median, max and min.).

In addition, how do you change the colour of the y axis?
opts(axis.line = theme_segment(colour = "black")) seems to only change
the x axis colour.

Thanks!

Cheers,

Michael
